name: chainindex
description: Developer-facing blockchain indexing and API SaaS targeting Ethereum Sepolia

scripts.build: npm run compile:contracts && node scripts/ponder.js codegen && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.build:indexer: npm run compile:contracts && node scripts/ponder.js codegen
scripts.compile:contracts: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.foundry/bin" && cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && npm run sync:abis
scripts.test:contracts: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.foundry/bin" && cd contracts && forge test -vvv
